messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning a sequential cutover to v2 tonight 02:00 UTC. main concern: some mobile SDKs are dropping the `X-Api-Version` header on 204 responses, which means clients may not opt-in correctly. Watching telemetry now.

sam: how many tenants are affected? any known big ones?

jordan: telemetry shows ~3 tenants with repeated missing header: tenant:acme-corp, tenant:oldbank, tenant:game-studio. small request volume but heavy mobile usage.

maya: proposal — pin those three to v1 for the cutover window, then gradually shift them once SDK patch rolls out. also add a proxy-level probe to detect missing header and tag requests.

sam: +1 on pin. deployment commands?

jordan: run this via deploy-bot:
```
/deploybot pin tenant:acme-corp v1 --until 2026-04-02T06:00Z
/deploybot pin tenant:oldbank v1 --until 2026-04-02T06:00Z
/deploybot pin tenant:game-studio v1 --until 2026-04-02T06:00Z
```

deploy-bot: pinned 3 tenants to v1 (acme-corp, oldbank, game-studio). Pins expire 2026-04-02T06:00Z.

ops: can we get an edge probe? suggest adding a hook that emits a metric `client_header_missing.count` with tenant tag. if that spikes -> auto-pause shift.

maya: agreed. rollback/runbook criteria: if 15m error rate > 2% (client-facing 5xx) OR P95 latency increases by > 300ms for the canary tenants -> pause and unpin. also abort if deploy-bot reports >10% canary failures.

sam: I'll update release notes and include the SDK note: "Mobile SDKs older than 3.1 may not send X-Api-Version on empty responses; customers should upgrade or be pinned to v1 during the window." PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2748 :memo:

jordan: ops, @ops can you schedule the proxy probe and a dashboard tile? need a fast visibility for tenant tag.

ops: on it — will create probe and a Grafana panel, alert @oncall if client_header_missing.count > 5 for 5m. ETA 30m.

maya: schedule: start sequential shift at 02:00 UTC with 5% traffic, advance 25m if stable, full traffic by 03:30 UTC. operator: @ops oncall for first hour. I'll be in channel. :thumbsup:

sam: added a short ops checklist to the PR and release notes. link in thread once merged.

jordan: leaving a quick note: if we see 'implicit-version' clients, consider adding a temporary shim that treats missing header as v1 for a tenant-level exception (low-risk fallback).

maya: good option — only if pinning causes unexpected regressions. otherwise keep pin + SDK patch plan.

deploy-bot: scheduled sequential cutover job: start=2026-04-01T02:00:00Z, strategy=sequential(5%,25%,50%,100%), watch=15m. operator=maya,ops.

maya: thanks, everyone. will post updates during the window.
